project_type: Serverless AWS CDK app - pnpm monorepo with lambdas, shared packages, infra, and React frontend
build_system: pnpm workspace with tsc for packages and infra, esbuild for lambda bundling (via CDK NodejsFunction or manual esbuild scripts)
verification_instructions: 1. pnpm install && pnpm build && pnpm test at repo root. 2. cd infra && npx --yes aws-cdk@2 synth. 3. Inspect cdk.out/asset.*/ directories for correct bundled output.
setup_instructions: export NVM_DIR=$HOME/.nvm && source $NVM_DIR/nvm.sh (provides node 22.23.2 + pnpm 10.28.1). Run pnpm install at repo root.
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network (npm registry accessible). No Docker daemon. No FFmpeg/ffprobe/pdftoppm/libreoffice. Node 22 + pnpm 10 available via nvm. Cannot run cdk deploy.
contribution_requirements: One branch from main (feat/mediaconvert-pipeline). One commit per task. No deploy. No PR creation. Tasks 1-15 from design doc section 7.
key_patterns: Lambdas in lambdas/*, shared packages in packages/*, infra constructs in infra/lib/. CDK uses Code.fromAsset for zip lambdas or NodejsFunction for auto-bundled. Polly-worker already uses NodejsFunction pattern. Others use raw Code.fromAsset with tsc output (broken). Workspace deps: @slide-first/shared-types, @slide-first/core. Tests use vitest with mocks for AWS SDK.
directory_structure: Root: pnpm monorepo. packages/shared-types (zod schemas, types), packages/core (business logic - duration, captions, s3-keys), packages/renderer-ffmpeg (FFmpeg command builders - to be deleted), packages/renderer-port (abstract port). lambdas/api, lambdas/caption-worker, lambdas/clip-worker, lambdas/concat-worker, lambdas/marp-render, lambdas/polly-worker, lambdas/slide-generator. infra/ (CDK with src/main-stack.ts, lib/*.ts constructs, bin/app.ts). frontend/ (React SPA with Vite).
